about.title: About — CIS Robotics
about.heading: About CIS Robotics
about.par1: CIS Robotics is a FIRST LEGO League team that combines design, programming and engineering to solve challenges creatively and ethically.
about.par2: We design robots, develop strategies, and prepare presentations to demonstrate our research and teamwork at regional competitions.
about.par3: Our primary code and experiments are in the repositories listed on the Projects page. Both are public on GitHub — contributions and feedback are welcome.
